title: Intersectionality in Disability Theory, Policy and Practice
description: Intersectional approach to diverse abilities, including visible and invisible disabilities, neurodiversity, LGBTQ2S+ identities and BIPOC perspectives. Focus on anti-ableist, decolonizing frameworks, prioritizing consumer autonomy and inclusive service delivery.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCW 469, HSD 464.
